Upon Written Request, Copies Available From: Securities and Exchange Commission, Office of FOIA Services, 100 F Street NE, Washington, DC 20549-2736
Notice is hereby given that pursuant to the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 (“PRA”) (44 U.S.C. 3501 et seq.), the Securities and Exchange Commission (“Commission”) is soliciting comments on the existing collection of information provided for in Rule 18a-5, under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C. 78a et seq.). The Commission plans to submit this existing collection of information to the Office of Management and Budget (“OMB”) for extension and approval.
Rule 18a-5 enumerates the recordkeeping and reporting requirements for security-based swap dealers (“SBSDs”) and major security-based swap participants (“MSBSPs”). More specifically, Rule 18a-5 establishes recordkeeping requirements applicable to stand-alone SBSDs, stand-alone MSBSPs, bank SBSDs, and bank MSBSPs. Rule 18a-5 was modeled on Rule 17a-3 under the Exchange Act, which applies to broker-dealers, but Rule 18a-5 does not include a parallel requirement for every requirement in Rule 17a-3 because some of the requirements in Rule 17a-3 relate to activities that are not expected or permitted of SBSDs and MSBSPs. The collections of information under Rule 18a-5 include the following types of records that are required to be created: trade blotters, general ledger, ledgers for customers and non-customer accounts, stock record, memoranda of brokerage orders, memoranda of proprietary orders, confirmations, accountholder information, options positions, trial balances and computation of net capital, associated person's employment application, account equity and margin calculations under Rule 18a-3, possession or control requirements for security-based swap customers, customer reserve requirements for security-based swap customers, unverified transactions, political contributions, and compliance with business conduct requirements. The purpose of requiring stand-alone SBSDs, stand-alone MSBSPs, bank SBSDs, and bank MSBSPs to create the records specified in Rule 18a-5 is to enhance regulators' ability to protect investors. These records and the information contained therein are used by examiners and other representatives of the Commission to determine whether stand-alone SBSDs, stand-alone MSBSPs, bank SBSDs, and bank MSBSPs are in compliance with the Commission's anti-fraud and anti-manipulation rules, financial responsibility program, and other laws, rules, and regulations.
Not all types of records enumerated in Rule 18a-5 are required to be made by each of the entities to which Rule 18a-5 applies. For example, Rule 18a-5 requires thirteen types of records to be made and kept current by stand-alone ( printed page 69018) SBSDs and stand-alone MSBSPs.[1] Rule 18a-5 also requires three types of records to be made and kept current by stand-alone SBSDs.[2] Rule 18a-5 requires 10 types of records to be made and kept current by bank SBSDs and bank MSBSPs, all of which are limited to the firm's business as an SBSD or MSBSP.[3] Further, Rule 18a-5 includes paragraphs (b)(9), (b)(10), and (b)(12) which requires bank SBSDs to make and keep current various records for security-based swaps.[4]
As of September 24, 2026, there are 15 stand-alone SBSDs, zero stand-alone MSBSPs, 29 bank SBSDs, and zero bank MSBSPs registered with the Commission. The Commission estimates that each recordkeeping provision of Rule 18a-5 imposes on each firm that is subject to the provision an initial burden and an ongoing annual burden. The total initial industry hour burden attributable to Rule 18a-5 is estimated to be 12,340 hours in the first year and the total industry ongoing hour burden attributable to Rule 18a-5 is estimated to be 15,425 hours per year (including the first year). Over a three-year period, the total estimated industry burden is estimated to be 58,615 hours, or about 19,538 hours per year when annualized. These burdens are recordkeeping burdens.
In addition, the Commission estimates that Rule 18a-5 causes a stand-alone SBSD or stand-alone MSBSP to incur an initial dollar cost of approximately $1,000 to purchase recordkeeping system software and an ongoing dollar cost of $4,650 per year to provide adequate physical space and computer hardware and software for storage. As of September 24, 2026, there are 15 respondents (15 stand-alone SBSDs and zero stand-alone MSBSPs), resulting in an estimated industry-wide initial burden of $15,000 and an industry-wide ongoing burden of $69,750 per year. Over a three-year period, the total estimated industry burden would be $224,250, or about $74,750 per year when annualized.
An agency may not conduct or sponsor, and a person is not required to respond to, a collection of information unless it displays a currently valid OMB Control Number.
Written comments are invited on: (a) whether this proposed collection of information is necessary for the proper performance of the functions of the SEC, including whether the information will have practical utility; (b) the accuracy of the SEC's estimate of the burden imposed by the proposed collection of information, including the validity of the methodology and the assumptions used; (c) ways to enhance the quality, utility, and clarity of the information to be collected; and (d) ways to minimize the burden of the collection of information on respondents, including through the use of automated, electronic collection techniques or other forms of information technology.
Please direct your written comments on this 60-Day Collection Notice to Austin Gerig, Director/Chief Data Officer, Securities and Exchange Commission, c/o Tanya Ruttenberg via email to PaperworkReductionAct@sec.gov by January 4, 2027.

[Investigation Nos. 731-TA-1550-1553 (Review)]
United States International Trade Commission.
The Commission hereby gives notice that it has instituted reviews pursuant to the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended, to determine whether revocation of the antidumping duty orders on polyester textured yarn from Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam would be likely to lead to continuation or recurrence of material injury. Pursuant to the Act, interested parties are requested to respond to this notice by submitting the information specified below to the Commission.
Instituted November 2, 2026. To be assured of consideration, the deadline for responses is December 2, 2026. Comments on the adequacy of responses may be filed with the Commission by January 12, 2027.
Judson Monson (202-205-3314), Office of Investigations, U.S. International Trade Commission, 500 E Street SW, Washington, DC 20436. Hearing-impaired persons can obtain information on this matter by contacting the Commission's TDD terminal on 202-205-1810. Persons with mobility impairments who will need special assistance in gaining access to the Commission should contact the Office of the Secretary at 202-205-2000. General information concerning the Commission may also be obtained by accessing its internet server ( https://www.usitc.gov). The public record for this proceeding may be viewed on the Commission's electronic docket (EDIS) at https://edis.usitc.gov.
Background. —On December 14, 2021, the Department of Commerce (“Commerce”) issued antidumping duty orders on imports of polyester textured yarn from Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam (86 FR 71031). The Commission is conducting reviews pursuant to section 751(c) of the Act, as amended (19 U.S.C. 1675(c)), to determine whether revocation of the orders would be likely to lead to continuation or recurrence of material injury to the domestic industry within a reasonably foreseeable time. Provisions concerning the conduct of this proceeding may be found in the Commission's Rules of Practice and Procedure at 19 CFR part 201, subparts A and B, and 19 CFR part 207, subparts A and F. The Commission will assess the adequacy of interested party responses to this notice of institution to determine whether to conduct full or expedited reviews. The Commission's determinations in any expedited reviews will be based on the facts available, which may include information provided in response to this notice.
Definitions. —The following definitions apply to these reviews:
(1) Subject Merchandise is the class or kind of merchandise that is within the scope of the five-year reviews, as defined by Commerce.
(2) The Subject Countries in these reviews are Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, and Vietnam.
(3) The Domestic Like Product is the domestically produced product or products which are like, or in the absence of like, most similar in characteristics and uses with, the Subject Merchandise. In its original determinations, the Commission defined a single Domestic Like Product as polyester textured yarn, that is coextensive with the scope.
(4) The Domestic Industry is the U.S. producers as a whole of the Domestic Like Product, or those producers whose collective output of the Domestic Like Product constitutes a major proportion of the total domestic production of the product. In its original determinations, the Commission defined the Domestic Industry as all producers of polyester textured yarn.
(5) The Order Date is the date that the antidumping duty orders under review became effective. In these reviews, the Order Date is December 14, 2021.
(6) An Importer is any person or firm engaged, either directly or through a parent company or subsidiary, in importing the Subject Merchandise into the United States from a foreign manufacturer or through its selling agent.
Participation in the proceeding and public service list. —Persons, including industrial users of the Subject Merchandise and, if the merchandise is sold at the retail level, representative consumer organizations, wishing to participate in the proceeding as parties must file an entry of appearance with the Secretary to the Commission, as provided in § 201.11(b)(4) of the Commission's rules, no later than 21 days after publication of this notice in the Federal Register . The Secretary will maintain a public service list containing the names and addresses of all persons, or their representatives, who are parties to the proceeding.
Former Commission employees who are seeking to appear in Commission five-year reviews are advised that they may appear in a review even if they participated personally and substantially in the corresponding underlying original investigation or an earlier review of the same underlying investigation. The Commission's designated agency ethics official has ( printed page 68972) advised that a five-year review is not the same particular matter as the underlying original investigation, and a five-year review is not the same particular matter as an earlier review of the same underlying investigation for purposes of 18 U.S.C. 207, the post-employment statute for Federal employees, and Commission rule 201.15(b) (19 CFR 201.15(b)), 79 FR 3246 (Jan. 17, 2014), 73 FR 24609 (May 5, 2008). Consequently, former employees are not required to seek Commission approval to appear in a review under Commission rule 19 CFR 201.15, even if the corresponding underlying original investigation or an earlier review of the same underlying investigation was pending when they were Commission employees. For further ethics advice on this matter, contact Charles Smith, Office of the General Counsel, at 202-205-3408.
Limited disclosure of business proprietary information (BPI) under an administrative protective order (APO) and APO service list. —Pursuant to § 207.7(a) of the Commission's rules, the Secretary will make BPI submitted in this proceeding available to authorized applicants under the APO issued in the proceeding, provided that the application is made no later than 21 days after publication of this notice in the Federal Register . Authorized applicants must represent interested parties, as defined in 19 U.S.C. 1677(9), who are parties to the proceeding. A separate service list will be maintained by the Secretary for those parties authorized to receive BPI under the APO.
Certification. —Pursuant to § 207.3 of the Commission's rules, any person submitting information to the Commission in connection with this proceeding must certify that the information is accurate and complete to the best of the submitter's knowledge. In making the certification, the submitter will acknowledge that information submitted in response to this request for information and throughout this proceeding or other proceeding may be disclosed to and used: (i) by the Commission, its employees and Offices, and contract personnel (a) for developing or maintaining the records of this or a related proceeding, or (b) in internal investigations, audits, reviews, and evaluations relating to the programs, personnel, and operations of the Commission including under 5 U.S.C. Appendix 3; or (ii) by U.S. government employees and contract personnel, solely for cybersecurity purposes. All contract personnel will sign appropriate nondisclosure agreements.
Written submissions. —Pursuant to § 207.61 of the Commission's rules, each interested party response to this notice must provide the information specified below. The deadline for filing such responses is on or before 5:15 p.m. on December 2, 2026. Pursuant to § 207.62(b) of the Commission's rules, eligible parties (as specified in Commission rule 207.62(b)(1)) may also file comments concerning the adequacy of responses to the notice of institution and whether the Commission should conduct expedited or full reviews. The deadline for filing such comments is on or before 5:15 p.m. on January 12, 2027. All written submissions must conform with the provisions of § 201.8 of the Commission's rules; any submissions that contain BPI must also conform with the requirements of §§ 201.6, 207.3, and 207.7 of the Commission's rules. The Commission's Handbook on Filing Procedures, available on the Commission's website at https://www.usitc.gov/​documents/​handbook_​on_​filing_​procedures.pdf, elaborates upon the Commission's procedures with respect to filings. Also, in accordance with §§ 201.16(c) and 207.3 of the Commission's rules, each document filed by a party to the proceeding must be served on all other parties to the proceeding (as identified by either the public or APO service list as appropriate), and a certificate of service must accompany the document (if you are not a party to the proceeding you do not need to serve your response).
Please note the Secretary's Office will accept only electronic filings at this time. Filings must be made through the Commission's Electronic Document Information System (EDIS, https://edis.usitc.gov). No in-person paper-based filings or paper copies of any electronic filings will be accepted until further notice.
No response to this request for information is required if a currently valid Office of Management and Budget (“OMB”) number is not displayed; the OMB number is 3117 0016/USITC No. 26-5-710, expiration date July 31, 2029. Public reporting burden for the request is estimated to average 15 hours per response. Please send comments regarding the accuracy of this burden estimate to the Office of Investigations, U.S. International Trade Commission, 500 E Street SW, Washington, DC 20436.
Inability to provide requested information. —Pursuant to § 207.61(c) of the Commission's rules, any interested party that cannot furnish the information requested by this notice in the requested form and manner shall notify the Commission at the earliest possible time, provide a full explanation of why it cannot provide the requested information, and indicate alternative forms in which it can provide equivalent information. If an interested party does not provide this notification (or the Commission finds the explanation provided in the notification inadequate) and fails to provide a complete response to this notice, the Commission may take an adverse inference against the party pursuant to § 776(b) of the Act (19 U.S.C. 1677e(b)) in making its determinations in the reviews.
Information To Be Provided in Response to This Notice of Institution: If you are a domestic producer, union/worker group, or trade/business association; import/export Subject Merchandise from more than one Subject Country; or produce Subject Merchandise in more than one Subject Country, you may file a single response. If you do so, please ensure that your response to each question includes the information requested for each pertinent Subject Country. As used below, the term “firm” includes any related firms.
Those responding to this notice of institution are encouraged, but not required, to visit the USITC's website at https://usitc.gov/​reports/​response_​noi_​worksheet, where one can download and complete the “NOI worksheet” Excel form for the subject proceeding, to be included as attachment/exhibit 1 of your overall response.
(1) The name and address of your firm or entity (including World Wide Web address) and name, telephone number, fax number, and Email address of the certifying official.
(2) A statement indicating whether your firm/entity is an interested party under 19 U.S.C. 1677(9) and if so, how, including whether your firm/entity is a U.S. producer of the Domestic Like Product, a U.S. union or worker group, a U.S. importer of the Subject Merchandise, a foreign producer or exporter of the Subject Merchandise, a U.S. or foreign trade or business association (a majority of whose members are interested parties under the statute), or another interested party (including an explanation). If you are a union/worker group or trade/business association, identify the firms in which your workers are employed or which are members of your association.
(3) A statement indicating whether your firm/entity is willing to participate in this proceeding by providing information requested by the Commission.
(4) A statement of the likely effects of the revocation of the antidumping duty orders on the Domestic Industry in ( printed page 68973) general and/or your firm/entity specifically. In your response, please discuss the various factors specified in § 752(a) of the Act (19 U.S.C. 1675a(a)) including the likely volume of subject imports, likely price effects of subject imports, and likely impact of imports of Subject Merchandise on the Domestic Industry.
(5) A list of all known and currently operating U.S. producers of the Domestic Like Product. Identify any known related parties and the nature of the relationship as defined in § 771(4)(B) of the Act (19 U.S.C. 1677(4)(B)).
(6) A list of all known and currently operating U.S. importers of the Subject Merchandise and producers of the Subject Merchandise in each Subject Country that currently export or have exported Subject Merchandise to the United States or other countries since the Order Date.
(7) A list of 3-5 leading purchasers in the U.S. market for the Domestic Like Product and the Subject Merchandise (including street address, World Wide Web address, and the name, telephone number, fax number, and Email address of a responsible official at each firm).
(8) A list of known sources of information on national or regional prices for the Domestic Like Product or the Subject Merchandise in the U.S. or other markets.
(9) If you are a U.S. producer of the Domestic Like Product, provide the following information on your firm's operations on that product during calendar year 2025, except as noted (report quantity data in pounds and value data in U.S. dollars, f.o.b. plant). If you are a union/worker group or trade/business association, provide the information, on an aggregate basis, for the firms in which your workers are employed/which are members of your association.
(a) Production (quantity) and, if known, an estimate of the percentage of total U.S. production of the Domestic Like Product accounted for by your firm's(s') production;
(b) Capacity (quantity) of your firm to produce the Domestic Like Product (that is, the level of production that your establishment(s) could reasonably have expected to attain during the year, assuming normal operating conditions (using equipment and machinery in place and ready to operate), normal operating levels (hours per week/weeks per year), time for downtime, maintenance, repair, and cleanup, and a typical or representative product mix);
(c) the quantity and value of U.S. commercial shipments of the Domestic Like Product produced in your U.S. plant(s);
(d) the quantity and value of U.S. internal consumption/company transfers of the Domestic Like Product produced in your U.S. plant(s); and
(e) the value of (i) net sales, (ii) cost of goods sold (COGS), (iii) gross profit, (iv) selling, general and administrative (SG&A) expenses, and (v) operating income of the Domestic Like Product produced in your U.S. plant(s) (include both U.S. and export commercial sales, internal consumption, and company transfers) for your most recently completed fiscal year (identify the date on which your fiscal year ends).
(10) If you are a U.S. importer or a trade/business association of U.S. importers of the Subject Merchandise from any Subject Country, provide the following information on your firm's(s') operations on that product during calendar year 2025 (report quantity data in pounds and value data in U.S. dollars). If you are a trade/business association, provide the information, on an aggregate basis, for the firms, which are members of your association.
(a) The quantity and value (landed, duty-paid but not including antidumping duties) of U.S. imports and, if known, an estimate of the percentage of total U.S. imports of Subject Merchandise from each Subject Country accounted for by your firm's(s') imports;
(b) the quantity and value (f.o.b. U.S. port, including antidumping duties) of U.S. commercial shipments of Subject Merchandise imported from each Subject Country; and
(c) the quantity and value (f.o.b. U.S. port, including antidumping duties) of U.S. internal consumption/company transfers of Subject Merchandise imported from each Subject Country.
(11) If you are a producer, an exporter, or a trade/business association of producers or exporters of the Subject Merchandise in any Subject Country, provide the following information on your firm's(s') operations on that product during calendar year 2025 (report quantity data in pounds and value data in U.S. dollars, landed and duty-paid at the U.S. port but not including antidumping duties). If you are a trade/business association, provide the information, on an aggregate basis, for the firms, which are members of your association.
(a) Production (quantity) and, if known, an estimate of the percentage of total production of Subject Merchandise in each Subject Country accounted for by your firm's(s') production;
(b) Capacity (quantity) of your firm(s) to produce the Subject Merchandise in each Subject Country (that is, the level of production that your establishment(s) could reasonably have expected to attain during the year, assuming normal operating conditions (using equipment and machinery in place and ready to operate), normal operating levels (hours per week/weeks per year), time for downtime, maintenance, repair, and cleanup, and a typical or representative product mix); and
(c) the quantity and value of your firm's(s') exports to the United States of Subject Merchandise and, if known, an estimate of the percentage of total exports to the United States of Subject Merchandise from each Subject Country accounted for by your firm's(s') exports.
(12) Identify significant changes, if any, in the supply and demand conditions or business cycle for the Domestic Like Product that have occurred in the United States or in the market for the Subject Merchandise in each Subject Country since the Order Date, and significant changes, if any, that are likely to occur within a reasonably foreseeable time. Supply conditions to consider include technology; production methods; development efforts; ability to increase production (including the shift of production facilities used for other products and the use, cost, or availability of major inputs into production); and factors related to the ability to shift supply among different national markets (including barriers to importation in foreign markets or changes in market demand abroad). Demand conditions to consider include end uses and applications; the existence and availability of substitute products; and the level of competition among the Domestic Like Product produced in the United States, Subject Merchandise produced in each Subject Country, and such merchandise from other countries.
(13) (OPTIONAL) A statement of whether you agree with the above definitions of the Domestic Like Product and Domestic Industry; if you disagree with either or both of these definitions, please explain why and provide alternative definitions.

（中央社記者蔡孟妤高雄2日電）國民黨高雄市長參選人柯志恩競辦今天指民進黨對手賴瑞隆3年前面對政治獻金案時喊告，但選後卻撤告，質疑怕司法檢調調查。賴瑞隆競總反批國民黨慣用抹黑手法，企圖以負面選戰達成目的。
柯志恩競選辦公室今天發布新聞稿表示，賴瑞隆昨天面對收受光電業者政治獻金，再次以「依法申報」、「把不相關的資料湊在一起抹黑」等用語推託，但根據媒體報導，賴瑞隆3年前同樣面對政治獻金問題，當時大聲喊告，選後卻悄悄撤告。
柯競辦指出，2023年立委選舉期間，時任國民黨發言人凌濤、李明璇揭露賴瑞隆收受雲豹大股東贊助成立「高雄市新世代教育基金會」並任董事長，質疑恐有對價關係。當時賴瑞隆喊告，但選後卻具狀撤告，讓地檢署只能處分不起訴。
柯競辦質疑，既然賴瑞隆自認清白，當初提告正是透過司法還自己清白的最佳機會，但為何選完就悄悄撤告，難道是怕司法檢調深入調查，籲賴瑞隆說清楚。
柯競辦強調，高雄市長個人品行操守為重中之重，但賴瑞隆卻連政治獻金和人事安排都說不清楚，根本是讓前市長謝長廷、陳菊及現任市長陳其邁3人蒙羞。
對此，賴瑞隆競選總部今天發聲明表示，國民黨過去慣用抹黑手法，卻無法獲得民眾買單，所以始終未達成政治目的；如今再次故技重施，企圖透過負面選戰達成政治目的。
賴競辦強調，法律程序與事實完全是兩回事。告訴的進行跟司法調查並無關係，若真有具體不法事證，檢調自有依法偵辦權責。國民黨一再故技重施，又扭曲其原意，得了便宜還賣乖，根本是看輕司法、小看人民智慧。
賴競總強調，「不要把寬厚拿來抹黑」，高雄人要的是具體政策、城市願景，不是一再重複的政治口水，呼籲國民黨停止負面選戰，讓選舉回歸理性討論。（編輯：張國政）1151102

民進黨基隆市長參選人童子瑋（左）2日下午到基隆廟口拜票，在奠濟宮前廣場與支持者（右）握手互動，對方提到童子瑋曾在她的社群留言，也希望童子瑋能在社群平台更活躍些。中央社記者王朝鈺攝 115年11月2日
（中央社記者王朝鈺基隆2日電）尋求連任的基隆市長謝國樑今天接受專訪時，提到民調領先不多；民進黨基隆市長參選人童子瑋表示，與其每天關注民調，不如關心市民的生活。
童子瑋下午到基隆廟口拜票，前往奠濟宮參香前，一名女性支持者提到童子瑋曾在她的社群留言。童子瑋說，每次颱風來襲，許多民眾會在社群平台標記他，他就會積極服務或爭取改善，社群互動很重要。
記者詢問與女性支持者的對談內容，童子瑋說，對方認為他的社群可以再活躍些，可以多「亂入」其他人的帳號留言，但他有時會害羞，日後會再積極點。
謝國樑上午接受專訪時說，目前民調領先不多，他對連任有信心，因為有做事，也推出「謝國樑12項建設」讓市民了解。
對此，童子瑋表示，與其每天關注民調，不如關心市民生活，今天有許多民眾通報颱風過後仍有電線脫落、路燈不亮、樹木倒地等未處理。感受市民生活的溫度比較重要，他會每天努力，戒慎恐懼地積極走訪，讓更多市民認識他想改變基隆的決心。
行政院長卓榮泰日前視察國道1號五堵至汐止拓寬工程，童子瑋陪同出席。國民黨基隆市黨部今天指控童子瑋隨後透過新聞稿、臉書（Facebook）貼文及宣傳圖卡強調個人爭取成果，是「假爭取、真收割」。
童子瑋說，與其不斷噴政治口水，不如為市民流下汗水。卓榮泰上任初期就核定這項計畫，他也積極爭取加快進度，公路局人員在卓榮泰和他面前答應，只要年底順利發包、明年初動工，4年半就可完成，比原先簡報的5年更快，他相信只要真正為基隆做事，市民會看得到。
此外，童子瑋進步基隆辦公室今天發布新聞稿指出，童子瑋昨天在網路節目透露，2014年基隆市長選舉的3名主要參選人，包括民進黨籍林右昌、當時代表國民黨參選的謝立功，以及國民黨出身、以無黨籍身分參選的前議長黃景泰，如今都支持他。
童子瑋也表示，親民黨主席宋楚瑜對他的支持，並非單純的政治選擇，更多來自兩代之間長年的情感連結，以及共同關心基隆發展的情誼。（編輯：張國政）1151102

民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋（中）2日錄製節目「新聞面對面」，他在錄影前接受媒體聯訪，談及被指看起來疲倦時表示，「我只是眼睛比較小一點」，強調精神狀況其實一直都滿好的。中央社記者王飛華攝 115年11月2日
（中央社記者黃麗芸台北2日電）是否再辦第2場辯論，台北市長蔣萬安說，理解對手沈伯洋想再辦的用意，很可惜沈沒好好把握。對此，民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋今天表示，沒好好把握的是蔣，提問都不回答反拿來做攻擊。
沈伯洋下午接受年代電視台「新聞面對面」節目主持人謝震武專訪錄影，媒體會前聯訪詢問，如何看台北市長蔣萬安競選總幹事羅智強今天說，沈伯洋競選總幹事吳思瑤來加LINE要討論第2次辯論事宜，但他先提出6點辯論規則；以及蔣受訪時表示，理解沈想再辦1場辯論的用意，很可惜沈沒好好把握，是否為怯戰。
沈伯洋表示，羅智強的言論問他本人即可，羅開心就好，自己常不知羅在講什麼。
他認為，蔣萬安個人可能心有定見，但自己一直覺得沒有好好把握的是蔣，因問了一堆問題都全部不回答，並將回答時間拿來做攻擊，變成兩邊一直沒有交集，非常可惜，所以自己當下才提出要第2場辯論，所以應該是要問蔣萬安為何一直不回答問題。
媒體追問，台中市長兼蔣萬安競選總部主委盧秀燕下午分別拜會台北市議會藍、白黨團，是否要幫蔣鞏固白營選票。
沈伯洋說，盧秀燕現在應該有滿多時間要來台北幫忙蔣萬安，但對自己來說，仍不太習慣將民眾分成是白營或藍營支持者，而是各式各樣在城市不同需求的民眾，針對各自不同需求去提出政見，這才是說服大家投票支持的最好方式，若預設成政黨支持者則較無那麼強的對話空間。
由於蔣陣營召開記者會說沈的都更政策很像在作夢，媒體問如何看他們舉前總統陳水扁當年參選台北市長的口號「有夢最美」，但「失望相隨」；另外，事實查核中心發現蔣萬安在辯論時所提內湖康樂街都更案內容和事實不符，且將都更卡關歸咎於航高限制也過於簡化。
沈伯洋表示，這個城市本就該要讓大家能有各式各樣理想可實現之處，但對方若用空洞口號做批評，蠻令人難過，但也因此大家會開始注意自己的政見，可檢視最初是如何提出住戶交換計畫和加速進入無限都更等緣由，反而是好事。
他認為，在辯論時針對細節討論很浪費秒數，但大家可以回看蔣當時所講內容有多少與事實不符，但這不是辯論重點，自己仍鎖定暢談立場、價值和城市未來發展方向給市民聽，兩人最大不同就是，蔣一直在開都更入口，自己則認為要能走到最後動工的出口才最重要，陪伴機制才是現在要做的。
媒體問到，因沈伯洋在社群平台Threads瀏覽量突破1億，卻被蔣萬安酸說是認知作戰專家，看法為何；另外，媒體人趙少康還提說民進黨歷任參選人就愛裝暖男，認為蔣萬安始終如一才是真暖男。
沈伯洋認為，蔣萬安都沒有在聽別人講話，自己早多次說過認知作戰是國跟國之間的戰爭，但蔣每次都扣這種帽子，並說破億瀏覽量是因自己經常回覆他人文章，都會計入在瀏覽次數內，加上選舉進入倒數階段，瀏覽數字自然會越來越高。
另外，趙少康和自己相識不到1個月，其評論不一定那麼精準，但許多親友認識他逾20、30年，網路上應該都可看到他們的評論，希望趙少康能跟他認識更長久，才知道是否一致。
沈伯洋說，民調高高低低，現階段要注意的其實是投票率，認為藍營投票率向來都很高，自己則是力拚將民調數字轉換成實質投票率。
媒體再問到，沈伯洋和高雄市長陳其邁市長通話，相談哪些市政問題；以及民進黨發動競總背板創意大賽，是否要營造歡樂選舉感。
沈伯洋說，自己蠻常和陳其邁討論市政，了解其高雄經驗，今天也討論相關都更議題等；另外也希望大家不要覺得政治距離很遠，所以希望用較歡樂、平易近人方式，讓大家了解要反應事情或得到回覆，並非難事。
因民進黨秘書長徐國勇說沈有規劃到外縣市和其他選將合體計畫，但沈說有空檔才有機會，媒體續問，是否因整體選情仍戒慎恐懼，以及後續是否會舉辦一些座談會活動。
沈伯洋表示，小型座談會從以前迄今都舉辦很多，政見會議也開上百場，會一直進行到選舉、甚或選後，了解大家在這座城市裡的不同需求；另台北選情都可感受到非常緊繃，主要仍以台北市民為主，但若有空檔到外縣市，會希望可以多提雙邊合作政見，不會脫離台北這個主軸，畢竟自己要選的是台北市長。
媒體提到，昨天結束大安文山區車掃活動後，有士林北投區的民眾建議可在關渡宮旁包船以進行「船掃」造勢，看法為何。
沈伯洋說，安全還是最重要的，也會遵守相關規範，現在還不清楚包船狀況，會盡快盤點再告訴大家後續進度。（編輯：張國政）1151102

苗栗縣議會民進黨團2日提案推動65歲以上長者免健保費，主張下修現行補助門檻，採不排富原則，由縣府編列預算實施。（苗栗縣議會民進黨團提供）中央社記者管瑞平傳真 115年11月2日
（中央社記者管瑞平苗栗縣2日電）苗栗縣議會民進黨團及藍營議員今天分別提案支持65歲以上長者免健保費，獲議會通過，但對於經費來源，藍、綠各有主張，縣長鍾東錦表示，若中央確定不補助，才會考慮動用縣款。
立法院10月16日三讀通過「老人福利法」第22條修正案，明訂近一年綜合所得稅率未達20%的65歲以上長者，健保費由中央全額補助，卻刪除原條文有關部分負擔費用或保險給付未涵蓋醫療費用無力負擔者，直轄市、縣（市）主管機關應予補助等內容。行政院是否副署成關注焦點。
苗栗縣議會包括議長李文斌在內等藍營議員，今天在議會臨時動議連署提案，建請縣府依據立法院表決通過的老人福利法修正內容實施，以減輕子女扶養負擔。
民進黨苗栗縣長參選人、縣議員陳品安6月即提出65歲以上長者免健保費政見，主張由縣府編列預算補助，不排富。陳品安與民進黨議會黨團也提臨時動議，建請縣府將現行80歲以上長者、70歲以上原住民的健保費補助門檻，分別下修至65歲及55歲，由縣府編列預算實施。
藍、綠陣營提案獲一併通過。苗栗縣議會民進黨團表示，雙方對於政策財源及執行責任主張並不相同，在中央修法仍有財源及制度爭議下，民進黨團主張，苗栗已有相關補助制度，縣府不用坐等立院修法結果，應主動擴大照顧範圍，儘速提出預算及實施辦法，讓政策早日落實。
民進黨團指出，縣府116年總預算較今年度增加61億元，縣府應在兼顧償債及既有福利下，妥善規劃財源，針對擴大健保費補助訂出具體實施期程。
縣長鍾東錦日前臉書粉專曾發文指出，若由縣府支付，「直接虧掉縣庫8億」，期望行政院依法副署，實現醫療均權、健康均權目標。他今天答詢表示，中央法規理應由中央埋單，苗栗縣老年人口多、財政稅收相對少，還得按計劃償還債務，如果行政院「真的睡著了」確定不補助，再考慮是否動用縣款。
鍾東錦會後透過縣府新聞稿強調，「全民健康保險」應是全國一致的國家級制度，若由地方自行負擔，恐加劇城鄉貧富差距導致權益不公；立法院已三讀通過修法，地方急於自行另立門檻，將造成政策重複與疊床架屋，65歲長者健保補助無關乎藍綠，相信總統賴清德和行政院長卓榮泰有智慧與能力，能從中央層級統籌解決問題。（編輯：張國政）1151102

欧美“黑色星期五”促销旺季来临前，欧盟对廉价小包裹开征处理费，叠加此前的关税、合规要求等，导致中国低价小商品跨境卖家经营压力增加，备货量大减。图为10月30日，一名行人走过法国西南部城市波尔多的圣凯瑟琳购物街。 （法新社）
（北京/布鲁塞尔综合讯）欧美“黑色星期五”促销旺季来临前，欧盟对廉价小包裹开征处理费，叠加此前的关税、合规要求等，导致中国低价小商品跨境卖家经营压力增加，备货量大减。
欧盟自11月1起，在对直邮消费者的小件包裹征收每类商品三元（欧元，下同，约4.3新元）关税的基础上，再增收新费用，对包裹中每类商品征收两欧元的处理费。
欧盟赶在黑色星期五、网络星期一及圣诞购物旺季前实施新规，可遏制低价商品，尤其是中国跨境电商商品涌入欧洲。
这项新规让中国跨境商品卖家陷入两难：把小包裹从中国直邮到海外消费者手中，会面临高税费；若提前把货物以批量出口方式运到欧洲仓库，又有库存积压和资金占用的问题。
中国媒体《经济观察报》指出，不少卖家因此选择减少备货，降低经营风险。
报道称，今年7月起实施的三欧元小包裹关税、最新的包裹处理费，叠加新合规要求，让中国跨境电商卖家面临更高的经营成本。往年11月27日的“黑色星期五”前，中国卖家都会提前大量备货，但今年卖家的备货量大减。
一位深圳跨境卖家透露，往年都按“黑五”预估销量的1.2倍备货，以防旺季断货。今年，他只按预估销量的一半做准备。报道形容：“过去他赌的是旺季销量，今年他赌不起的是欧盟新关税下的试错成本”。
另一位义乌卖家则透露，去年“黑五”，他在主要销售市场安排了41款商品入海外仓，今年减至33款，计划入仓总量约为去年同期的35%。
今年7月1日，欧盟取消150欧元以下的小额包裹关税豁免政策，包裹内每类商品均面临三欧元的临时固定关税。欧盟官方解释，征收处理费是基于清查小包裹带来的海关工作成本。
中国卖家也面临补齐小商品相关合规资料的压力。一名地方电子商务科工作人员称，自7月1日起，欧盟还将产品标识、合格认证、生产者延伸责任相关要求，由指导性合规指引调整为强制性法定义务，资料不全的货物无法在欧盟完成清关。
有卖家申诉，一些低价小商品很难备齐完整材料，一旦资料缺失，整批货物就可能遭遇清关受阻。
据法新社报道，自欧盟今年7月实施三欧元小包裹关税以来，相关进口量已下降约64%。
中国跨境电商平台已开始调整经营策略。据路透社报道，为减轻新收费对低价商品吸引力的冲击，拼多多的跨境电商平台Temu已经向一些消费者提供新折扣，阿里巴巴旗下速卖通则正扩大欧洲当地的仓储量。

## 美国期中选举前夕 川普与民主党分别造势催票

（法新社华盛顿2日电） 美国期中选举前夕，民主党今天准备举行最后一波催票造势，总统川普也将在华府发表选前最后演说。外界预期，民主党至少能拿下国会其中一院的控制权，两年来首度能在政治上制衡川普。

发表时间： 02/11/2026 - 12:34

6 分钟 浏览时间

德州的塔拉里格（James Talarico）与堪萨斯州的韩密尔顿（Adam Hamilton）等民主党明星级联邦参议员候选人的造势集会，将为这场充满紧张与激烈竞争的选战划下句点。

川普（Donald Trump）则预定今天在华府林肯纪念堂（Lincoln Memorial）倒影池（Reflecting Pool）发表选前最后演说。他昨天才强调：「我们会赢。」

然而民调显示，民主党几乎笃定能从共和党手中夺下联邦众议院多数席次，也有机会赢得目前由共和党掌控的联邦参议院。

即使只拿下众议院，民主党也将掌握联邦预算的表决权，并主导富有权力的委员会，得以调查川普政府涉嫌贪腐的行径、已故性犯罪富豪艾普斯坦（Jeffrey Epstein）案的档案，以及其他极具争议的议题。

共和党若全面失去掌控国会的优势，川普将陷入陌生且不利的处境：在「跛脚鸭」（lame duck）任期中面临国内高通膨、对伊朗战事进展不顺，以及民主党对他在华府作为展开的调查。

不过，民主党人对胜选的预测依然保持警惕。此外，民主党在选战尾声面临内部分歧，左派候选人不时与党内建制派发生冲突。

例如，密西根州民主党籍众议员史蒂文斯（Haley Stevens）在该州关键的参议员选战中，昨天倒戈支持共和党候选人罗杰斯（Mike Rogers），而非同党的左翼进步派候选人塞德（Abdul El-Sayed）。

川普所属的共和党则采取政治焦土战术，将民主党人描绘成共产主义者，并公开将信奉伊斯兰教的塞德贴上恐怖分子标签。

然而，美国国家广播公司新闻网（NBC News）昨天公布的民调显示，6成受访者不满川普的施政表现，尤其是物价高涨问题。川普对伊朗发动的战争已持续8个月，让物价问题雪上加霜。

尽管众议院很可能改由民主党当家，参议院选战仍胜负未定。不过，民主党候选人在某些共和党铁票州出乎意料构成强力挑战，民调专家如今认为，民主党拿下参议院的胜算至少有5成。

若民主党在参议院占多数，将能阻止川普提名的终身职法官人选获得任命，包括最高法院大法官。

虽然本月3日才是投票日，全美已有创纪录的5400万人提前投票。

本次期中选举的广告支出约达110亿美元，其中很大一部分来自个别的超级金主，例如川普亲近盟友马斯克（Elon Musk）已捐出惊人的近5亿美元，以协助共和党候选人当选。

# 台北市长选举辩论后 民进党参选人沈伯洋民调首度突破五成

台湾韬略策进学会在2日公最新民调显示，沈伯洋支持度首度突破5成，来到52.6%，胜于蒋万安的35.3%，双方支持度拉大到17.3%。在选举看好度方面，沈伯洋也首度超越蒋万安，出现「黄金交叉」。

发表时间： 02/11/2026 - 10:34

 6 分钟 浏览时间

 台北街头。摄于10月6日。 © REUTERS - Ann Wang摄影

 作者： [台北特约记者 陈筱涵](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85/%E5%8F%B0%E5%8C%97%E7%89%B9%E7%BA%A6%E8%AE%B0%E8%80%85-%E9%99%88%E7%AD%B1%E6%B6%B5/ "台北特约记者 陈筱涵")

广告

继续浏览后续

距离九合一大选不到一个月，台北市长蒋万安、民进党候选人沈伯洋电视辩论在31日结束。 TVBS民调中心在1日火速民调，显示辩论表现有47%民众认为沈伯洋表现较好，领先蒋万安的40%。但民调同时也调查「不论有没有看辩论若明天投票挺谁」，结果蒋万安支持度46%，沈伯洋支持度则为42%。

国民党立委徐巧芯分析这份民调结果，她认为蒋万安支持者因为很紧张，不太敢看辩论。因此民调显示，沈伯洋支持者超过一半看辩论，蒋万安支持者则是超过一半没有看辩论。而看辩论的民众里支持沈伯洋领先比较多，但最后满意度却是沈伯洋领先比较少。她指出，也就是说，就算是支持沈伯洋的人，也有人认为蒋万安辩论表现比较好。

不过，台湾韬略策进学会在2日公最新民调显示，沈伯洋支持度首度突破5成，来到52.6%，胜于蒋万安的35.3%，双方支持度拉大到17.3%。蒋万安甚至跌破泛蓝40%的基本盘，沈伯洋则以52.6%成功外溢冲破泛绿的35% 基本盘。在选举看好度方面，沈伯洋也首度超越蒋万安，以47.9℅赢过蒋万安的40.1℅，出现「黄金交叉」。

资深记者赵晓慧表示，这份民调有其代表性，采用「市话 6成、手机 4成」的双底册抽样，成功抓到白天不在家、客厅没装第四台、只用智慧型手机的 20 到 45 岁庞大「剪线族」与都会白领。可以显示沈伯洋在青年世代的压倒性支持（近六成至七成），直接被手机底册如实反映出来。

但值得注意的是，这份民调有「沉默螺旋」。这个群体可能是泛白选民，同样对蒋万安失望，但心里也有「讨厌民进党」这一道坎，还要观察到最后一刻再发动「弃保」投票。另外还有「尚未决定」7.7%的民众。

对于民调结果，两位参选人都在2日回应。沈伯洋表示，他不敢大意，仍会戒慎恐惧。而蒋万安重申，自己想不管民调，就是吹起反攻的号角，呼吁认同台北市这四年来各项建设以及进步的市民，站出来坚定投票。

此外，民调专家戴立安也表示，他认为台北市有强烈的变天讯号，因为浅蓝选民已经跑票。

content:
美国股市波动，台湾股市收低但脱离低点 - 焦点台湾
台湾股市收跌，但因美国波动而脱离低点
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月2日电 交易商称，台湾股市周一收盘下跌，但从当日低点回升，原因是市场仍然担心美国在人工智能基础设施方面的大规模支出引发的市场波动。
台湾证券交易所基准指数在 44,399.10 点至 45,156.17 点之间波动，最终下跌 291.69 点，至 44,920.14 点，跌幅为 0.65%。继周五的 9,396.1 亿新台币之后，成交总额达到 7,588.8 亿新台币（232.5 亿美元）。
交易商表示，该指数早盘面临巨大压力，暴跌 812.73 点至当日低点，主要是由于以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌 2.86%，周五费城半导体指数暴跌 7.20%。
然而，交易商补充称，随着逢低买入者买入部分市场落后企业的股票，包括智能手机IC设计商联发科、iPhone组装商和人工智能服务器制造商鸿海精密工业有限公司的股票，当地市场收复了早前的大部分跌幅。
华南证券分析师Kevin Su表示，“对于逢低买入者来说，今天上午的下跌为包括联发科和鸿海在内的一些市场落后者创造了买入机会。”
联发科上涨 1.40%，收于新台币 3,970.00 元，脱离新台币 3,795.00 元的低点；鸿海上涨 2.24%，收于新台币 251.00 元，脱离新台币的低点 242.50 元。
电源管理解决方案供应商台达电子公司(Delta Electronics Inc.)也是逢低吸纳的焦点，该公司股价上涨1.50%，收于新台币1,355.00元。
Su 表示：“存储芯片供应商三星电子和 SK 海力士在首尔的反弹也引发了购买。” “对于区域市场来说，美国股市的暴跌似乎并不是世界末日。”
台湾存储芯片生产商南亚科技股价上涨0.44%，收于新台币456.50元，脱离低点新台币424.50元。
然而，合约芯片制造商台积电 (TSMC) 的美国存托凭证周五下跌 5.95%，其收盘未能上涨，下跌 1.69%，至新台币 2,330.00 元。
苏表示，原油价格飙升提振了石化库存，进一步提振了台交所。
台塑涨4.78%，收于新台币103.00元；南亚塑胶涨1.69%，收于新台币301.00元。台塑收涨0.83%，报新台币73.10元；台化纤收涨1.52%，报新台币73.60元。
因改善国家电网投资而跑赢大盘，富成电机收涨0.73%，至新台币555.00元；中新电机制造股份有限公司收涨0.65%，至新台币154.00元。
金融板块，富邦金控跌1.24%，报159.50元新台币；中信金控跌1.06%，报75.00新台币。
苏说：“随着新台币兑美元继续走弱，我怀疑今天购买大型科技股的资金来自政府主导的基金，而不是外国投资者，以增强投资者信心。”
“成交量下降表明人们对定于周二举行的美国中期选举持谨慎态度，”苏补充道。
据台湾证券交易所统计，周一外国机构投资者在主板净售股新台币735.2亿美元。

Taiwan shares end down but off lows amid U.S. volatility
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 2 (CNA) Shares in Taiwan closed down Monday but recovered from the day's low as the market remained concerned about volatility in the United States amid questions over massive spending on AI infrastructure, dealers said.
The Taiex, the Taiwan Stock Exchange's benchmark index, ended down 291.69 points, or 0.65 percent, at 44,920.14 after moving between 44,399.10 and 45,156.17. Turnover totaled NT$758.88 billion (US$23.25 billion) following Friday's NT$939.61 billion.
The index faced heavy pressure in the early-morning session, tumbling 812.73 points to the day's low, largely on a 2.86 percent fall on the tech-heavy Nasdaq index and a 7.20 percent plunge on the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index Friday, dealers said.
However, the local market recouped most of its earlier losses as bargain hunters picked up shares in select market laggards, including smartphone IC designer MediaTek and iPhone assembler and AI server maker Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., dealers added.
"For bargain hunters, this morning's losses created buying opportunities for some market laggards with MediaTek and Hon Hai included," Hua Nan Securities analyst Kevin Su said.
MediaTek rose 1.40 percent to close at NT$3,970.00, off a low of NT$3,795.00 and Hon Hai gained 2.24 percent to end at NT$251.00, off a low of NT$242.50.
Also a focus of bargain hunting, power management solutions provider Delta Electronics Inc. added 1.50 percent to close at NT$1,355.00.
"Buying was also sparked by a rally among memory chip suppliers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix in Seoul," Su said. "The U.S. tumble appeared not to be the end of the world to regional markets."
Shares in Taiwan's memory chip producer Nanya Technology Corp. rose 0.44 percent to end at NT$456.50, off a low of NT$424.50.
However, contract chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) failed to end in positive territory, dropping 1.69 percent to NT$2,330.00, after a 5.95 percent fall in its American depositary receipts Friday.
A spike in crude oil prices bolstered petrochemical stocks, giving an additional boost to the Taiex, Su said.
Formosa Petrochemical Corp. rose 4.78 percent to close at NT$103.00, Nan Ya Plastics Corp. gained 1.69 percent to end at NT$301.00. Formosa Plastics Corp. closed up 0.83 percent at NT$73.10, and Formosa Chemicals & Fibre Corp. ended up 1.52 percent at NT$73.60.
Also outperforming the broader market in the wake of investments to improve the national electricity grid, Fortune Electric Co. closed up 0.73 percent at NT$555.00 and Chung-Hsin Electric & Machinery Manufacturing Corp. ended up 0.65 percent at NT$154.00.
In the financial sector, Fubon Financial Holding Co. closed down 1.24 percent at NT$159.50 and CTBC Financial Holding Co. fell 1.06 percent at NT$75.00.
"As the Taiwan dollar continued to weaken against the greenback, I suspect today's buying of large tech stocks came from government-led funds, instead of foreign investors, to bolster investor confidence," Su said.
"Lower turnover showed caution about the U.S. midterm elections scheduled for Tuesday," Su added.
According to the Taiwan Stock Exchange, foreign institutional investors sold a net NT$73.52 billion of shares on the main board Monday.

content:
台湾将流感和 COVID-19 疫苗接种范围扩大到 50-64 岁的成年人 - 焦点台湾
台湾将流感和 COVID-19 疫苗接种范围扩大到 50-64 岁的成年人
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
周一，一名公众接种了疫苗。中央通讯社照片2026年11月2日
中新社台北11月2日电 台湾公共资助的流感和COVID-19疫苗接种计划的第二阶段于周一开始，年龄在50-64岁的健康人群现在有资格接种疫苗。
卫生部副部长庄人祥在台北市南港区的疫苗接种站卷起袖子接受了两针注射，疾病预防控制中心在此举行新闻发布会，标志着第二阶段计划的启动。
Chang 说，流感和 COVID-19 疫苗不仅可以预防感染，还可以降低严重疾病和并发症的风险，包括影响心脏和肺部的并发症。他敦促 50 岁及以上的健康成年人尽快接种疫苗。
CDC发言人林明诚在新闻发布会后对记者表示，预计本周台湾流感活动将降至11%以下的流行阈值。
根据疾病预防控制中心的监测标准，疫情必须连续两周保持在阈值以下才能宣布结束，这意味着最早可能会在下周宣布结束。
然而，林警告说，即使疫情平息后，严重疾病和死亡的风险仍然存在。他说，超过 99% 的重症病例和死亡病例涉及未接种本季流感疫苗或 COVID-19 疫苗的人。
庄和林都敦促老年人、孕妇、慢性病患者和 50 岁及以上的健康成年人尽快接种流感和 COVID-19 疫苗，以保护自己并降低患严重疾病和并发症的风险。
第一阶段疫苗接种计划于10月1日开始，但仅限于医疗专业人员； 65 岁及以上的人； 55岁及以上的原住民；住在长期护理机构的人们及其工作人员； 6 个月至学龄前儿童；孕妇；以及患有既往疾病（包括慢性疾病）的人。
CDC 数据显示，10 月份总共注射了 585 万剂流感和 COVID-19 疫苗。
与此同时，疾病预防控制中心主任罗一钧周一在新北举行的另一场新闻发布会上表示，最新的 COVID-19 疫苗比以前的版本副作用更少。
罗说，这种更新后的疫苗用量为之前剂量的五分之一，副作用较少，局部红肿和疼痛也明显减轻，鼓励公众放心接种。
疾病预防控制中心主任罗宜群周一接受疫苗接种。中央通讯社照片2026年11月2日
Lo说，尽管人们普遍认为50-64岁的人患有较少的慢性疾病和健康风险，但统计数据显示，该年龄段的流感和COVID-19重症病例均排名第二。
Lo补充说，尽管第二阶段将疫苗接种资格扩大到50-64岁的健康成年人，但其他高危人群，包括患有慢性疾病的人、65岁及以上的老年人和儿童，仍然有资格接种疫苗。
（陈杰玲、曹亚燕、柯林撰）

Taiwan expands flu, COVID-19 shots to adults aged 50-64
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
A member of the general public is inoculated with a vaccine on Monday. CNA photo Nov. 2, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 2 (CNA) The second phase of Taiwan's publicly funded influenza and COVID-19 vaccination program began Monday, with healthy people aged 50-64 now eligible to receive the shots.
Deputy Health Minister Chuang Jen-hsiang (莊人祥) rolled up his sleeve and received both shots at a vaccination station in Taipei's Nangang District, where the Centers for Disease Control (CDC) held a news conference to mark the launch of the program's second phase.
Chuang said flu and COVID-19 vaccinations can not only prevent infections but also reduce the risk of severe illness and complications, including those affecting the heart and lungs. He urged healthy adults aged 50 and older to get vaccinated as soon as possible.
Speaking to reporters after the press event, CDC spokesperson Lin Min-cheng (林明誠) said flu activity in Taiwan is expected to fall below the 11 percent epidemic threshold this week.
Under the CDC's monitoring criteria, the outbreak must remain below the threshold for two consecutive weeks before it can be declared over, meaning the announcement could come as early as next week.
However, Lin warned that the risk of severe illness and death remains even after the outbreak subsides. More than 99 percent of severe cases and deaths have involved people who had not received this season's flu vaccine or a COVID-19 vaccine, he said.
Both Chuang and Lin urged seniors, pregnant women, people with chronic illnesses and healthy adults aged 50 and older, to get vaccinated against flu and COVID-19 as soon as possible to protect themselves and reduce the risk of severe illness and complications.
The first phase of the vaccination program began on Oct. 1 but was limited to medical professionals; people aged 65 and older; Indigenous people aged 55 and older; people living in long-term care facilities and their staff; children aged 6 months through preschool age; pregnant women; and people with preexisting conditions, including chronic illnesses.
CDC data showed that a total of 5.85 million doses of flu and COVID-19 vaccines were administered in October.
Meanwhile, CDC Director-General Lo Yi-chun (羅一鈞) said at a separate news conference in New Taipei on Monday that the latest COVID-19 vaccine has fewer side effects than previous versions.
This updated vaccine uses one-fifth of the previous dose and causes fewer side effects, with localized redness and pain also significantly reduced, Lo said, encouraging members of the public to get vaccinated without concern.
CDC Director-General Lo Yi-chun receives a vaccination on Monday. CNA photo Nov. 2, 2026
Although people aged 50-64 are generally perceived as having fewer chronic illnesses and health risks, Lo said, statistics show that this age group ranks second in terms of severe cases of both flu and COVID-19.
Lo added that although the second phase expands eligibility to healthy adults aged 50-64, other high-risk groups, including people with chronic illnesses, seniors aged 65 and older, and children, remain eligible for vaccination.
(By Chen Chieh-ling, Tsao Ya-yen and Ko Lin)

content:
三个赛季过去了，台湾滕凯伟终于感觉自己像MLB球员了 - 聚焦台湾
棒球/三个赛季台湾选手滕凯伟终于感觉自己像 MLB 球员了
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
台湾右手投手滕凯伟周一在台北举行的媒体聚会上向报道和球迷致意。中央通讯社照片2026年11月2日
中新社台北11月2日电 对于台湾右投手邓恺威来说，2026年随休斯顿太空人队首次入选美国职业棒球大联盟开幕日名单让他感觉自己属于大联盟。
周一在台北举行的媒体聚会上，滕在回顾自己 2026 年的旅程时表示，在大联盟开始新赛季让他比在旧金山巨人队的前两年更有信心，当时的机会取决于伤病或其他阵容需求。
“入选开幕日名单让我感觉自己是一名真正的大联盟球员，”滕说。 “面对那些大联盟的击球手，我感到更加自在和自信。”
12月1日，滕将年满28岁，他在牛棚开始了2026年的职业生涯，之后因伤进入了轮换阵容。后来他在伤病名单上和未成年人中度过了一段时间，同时努力恢复状态。
启程国际运动行销 Athletics Sports（@athletics.sports_）分享的贴文
在太空人队的第一年表现并不均衡，腾在 30 场比赛中取得了 5 胜 7 负的战绩，自责失分率为 4.76，其中包括 10 场首发。他的 73 个三振、73 2/3 局和出场总数均为大联盟职业生涯新高。
滕说，当他伤愈复出后，休斯顿将他送下场时，球队解释说他需要进一步恢复和调整，以解决因补偿伤病而造成的身体问题。
“我有一个明确的目标，知道我需要做什么，”他说。 “不像以前，我一直想着什么时候才能重新站起来，变得太不耐烦了。”
滕还表示，去年他从巨人队队友乔伊·卢切西那里得到的建议帮助他信任了自己的投球。
滕的做法是专注于避开击球手的热点区域，同时瞄准角球，但结果却屡屡错过好球区。
“球探报告只是一个参考，最重要的是相信你的东西能把他们带出去。”滕回忆道。他记得卢凯西告诉他：“如果你害怕，事后你会后悔的。”
2025 年 9 月 19 日，在洛杉矶观看巨人队队友罗比·雷 (Robbie Ray) 向道奇队 (Dodgers) 的大谷翔平 (Shohei Ohtani) 打出全垒打后，滕牢记了这一建议。
雷向球探报告中推荐的位置投出了一记高位外线快球，但滕决定在同一区域挑战大谷。
第二天，滕在第一局用四缝快球三振了大谷，他说这次经历让他对顶级击球手更有信心。
滕将自己和许多队友比作日本漫画《高知龟》中的交警本田，每次骑摩托车时，本田的温和态度都会发生巨大变化。
“在场外，他们真的是很好的人，但在场上，这是关于胜利而不是屈服，”他说。
这种态度也影响了他选择台湾歌手伍佰的《墓仔埔也敢去》作为他的入场音乐。
滕表示，他认同公司为了追求目标愿意去任何地方，并且希望无所畏惧地面对强大的对手。
他还赞扬了休斯顿对国际赛事的支持

Three seasons in, Taiwan's Teng Kai-wei finally feels like MLB player - Focus Taiwan
BASEBALL/Three seasons in, Taiwan's Teng Kai-wei finally feels like MLB player
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taiwanese right-handed pitcher Teng Kai-wei greets reports and fans at a media gathering in Taipei on Monday. CNA photo Nov. 2, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 2 (CNA) For Taiwanese right-handed pitcher Teng Kai-wei (鄧愷威), making a Major League Baseball Opening Day roster for the first time with the Houston Astros in 2026 helped him feel he belonged in the majors.
Recounting his 2026 journey at a media gathering in Taipei on Monday, Teng said beginning the season in the majors gave him more confidence than in his previous two years with the San Francisco Giants, when opportunities depended on injuries or other roster needs.
"Making the Opening Day roster made me feel like I was truly a major league player," Teng said. "Facing those major league hitters, I felt more comfortable and confident."
Teng, who turns 28 on Dec. 1, began 2026 in the bullpen before moving into an injury-hit rotation. He later spent time on the injured list and in the minors while working to regain his form.
啟程國際運動行銷 Athletics Sports（@athletics.sports_）分享的貼文
In what was an uneven first year with the Astros, Teng finished with a 5-7 record and a 4.76 ERA in 30 appearances, including 10 starts. His 73 strikeouts, 73 2/3 innings and appearance total were major league career highs.
When Houston sent him down after his return from injury, the team explained that he needed further recovery and adjustments to address physical issues caused by compensating for the injury, Teng said.
"I had a clear goal and knew what I needed to do," he said. "It wasn't like before, when I kept thinking about when I could get back up and became too impatient."
Teng also credited advice he received last year from Giants teammate Joey Lucchesi that helped him trust his pitches.
Teng's approach was to focus on avoiding hitters' hot zones, while aiming for the corners but repeatedly missing the strike zone as a result.
"Scouting reports are only a reference. The most important thing is to believe your stuff can get them out," Teng recalled. He remembered Lucchesi telling him: "If you pitch scared, you'll regret it afterward."
Teng kept that advice in mind after watching Giants teammate Robbie Ray surrender a home run to the Dodgers' Shohei Ohtani in Los Angeles on Sept. 19, 2025.
Ray had delivered a high, outside fastball to a location recommended in the scouting report, but Teng decided he would challenge Ohtani in the same area.
The following day, Teng struck out Ohtani on a four-seam fastball in the first inning, an experience he said gave him greater confidence against top hitters.
Teng compared himself and many teammates to Honda, a traffic police officer in the Japanese manga "KochiKame," whose mild manner changes dramatically whenever he rides a motorcycle.
"Off the field, they're really nice people, but on the field, it's about winning and not giving in," he said.
That attitude also informed his choice of Taiwanese singer Wu Bai's (伍佰) "Go To The Graveyard" (墓仔埔也敢去), whose Taiwanese-language title roughly means "I'd even dare go to a graveyard," as his entrance music.
Teng said he identified with its willingness to go anywhere in pursuit of a goal and wanted to face formidable opponents without fear.
He also praised Houston's support for international players, including assistance with rental neighborhoods and Asian restaurants, and a clubhouse whiteboard featuring multilingual expressions.
On the mound, he said, Houston allowed him to use his preferred position in the middle of the pitching rubber, rather than the more off-center position he had been asked to adopt with the Giants for particular pitches.
As for next year -- which may be delayed or even not played because of a lockout as MLB owners seek to impose a salary cap on the players -- Teng will be under team control though it is unclear if he has officially signed a contract yet.
Teng seemed confident he would be with the team in 2027 but said the Astros had yet to discuss whether he would start or relieve.
"If I'm only a starter and there's no opening up there, it's harder," he said. "Being able to do both gives me more opportunities."

content:
16位台湾青年农业大使将访问荷兰 - 聚焦台湾
16位台湾青年农业大使访问荷兰
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
外交部长林家龙（后右五）周一举行活动，介绍16名台湾年轻农业专家前往荷兰参加一年一度的政府资助的农业交流计划。中央通讯社照片2026年11月2日
中新社台北11月2日电 外交部长林佳龙周一举行活动，介绍16位前往荷兰参加年度政府资助农业交流计划的台湾年轻农业专家。
林在外交部台北总部举行的仪式上表示，青年农业大使计划于2017年启动，由外交部和农业部共同举办。
其初衷是为了促进台湾与新南向政策所覆盖国家的交流。
林说，自该项目启动以来，已有150多名年龄在18岁至45岁之间的农业、林业、渔业和畜牧业大使前往澳大利亚、印度尼西亚、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚、印度和泰国。
林说，今年是该计划首次派团到新南向政策范围之外的国家。
他说，荷兰之所以被选为今年的目的地，是因为荷兰以其花卉业而闻名于世，并且是智能农业的先驱。
台湾和荷兰也保持着密切的农业合作，双方自1993年起举行农业工作组会议，建立了林所说的“深厚而牢固的农业伙伴关系”。
时任总统蔡英文于2016年推出新南向政策，旨在扩大台湾与东盟10个成员国、南亚6个国家、澳大利亚和新西兰的经济、教育和文化联系。
与此同时，荷兰驻台北办事处副代表Matthijs van der Hoorn在仪式上致辞时强调了荷兰与台湾之间“强大、稳健和长期”的农业关系。
荷兰驻台北办事处副代表Matthijs van der Hoorn。中央通讯社照片2026年11月2日
他说：“我们一直在知识交流、大多成功的商业配对活动以及解决复杂的行星和星际市场准入问题方面进行合作。”
他说：“对于今年选出的年轻农业投资者来说，你们代表了农业的未来。”他补充说，他们的旅程将“为下一代农业解决方案铺平道路”。
据外交部介绍，本届代表团由农、林、渔业、畜牧、花卉、环境农业、果蔬生产销售、畜牧业等领域的青年专业人士组成。
外交部表示，代表团计划于11月8日离开台湾，前往荷兰进行为期八天的访问，其间代表团成员将与荷兰同行加强双方在花卉栽培、可控环境农业、畜牧业、果蔬生产和营销方面的合作。
公众对台湾金融服务的信心升至64。

16 young Taiwanese agricultural ambassadors to visit the Netherlands
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (fifth right from back) holds an event on Monday to introduce 16 young Taiwanese agricultural experts who are heading to the Netherlands to take part in an annual government-funded agricultural exchange program. CNA photo Nov. 2, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 2 (CNA) Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) on Monday held an event to introduce 16 young Taiwanese agricultural experts who are heading to the Netherlands to take part in an annual government-funded agricultural exchange program.
Speaking at a ceremony at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' (MOFA) Taipei headquarters, Lin said the Young Agricultural Ambassadors program was launched in 2017 and is co-organized by MOFA and the Ministry of Agriculture.
It was originally designed to promote exchanges between Taiwan and countries covered by the New Southbound Policy.
Since the program's inception, more than 150 ambassadors aged 18-45, specializing in agriculture, forestry, fisheries and animal husbandry have traveled to Australia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, India and Thailand, Lin said.
This year marks the first time the program has sent a delegation to a country outside the scope of the New Southbound Policy, Lin said.
The Netherlands was chosen as this year's destination because it is globally renowned for its floriculture industry and is a pioneer in smart agriculture, he said.
Taiwan and the Netherlands have also maintained close agricultural cooperation, with the two sides holding agricultural working group meetings since 1993 and fostering what Lin described as "a deep and robust agricultural partnership."
The New Southbound Policy was launched in 2016 under then-President Tsai Ing-wen (蔡英文) to expand Taiwan's economic, educational and cultural ties with the 10 ASEAN member states, six South Asian countries, Australia and New Zealand.
Meanwhile, Matthijs van der Hoorn, deputy representative of the Netherlands Office Taipei, highlighted the "strong, robust and long-standing" agricultural relationship between the Netherlands and Taiwan, during his address at the ceremony.
Matthijs van der Hoorn, deputy representative of the Netherlands Office Taipei. CNA photo Nov. 2, 2026
"We have been collaborating in knowledge exchange, mostly successful business matchmaking events, and tackling complex planetary and interplanetary market access issues," he said.
"To the young agricultural investors selected this year, you represent the future of agriculture," he said, adding that their journey would "pave the way for the next generation of agricultural solutions."
According to MOFA, this year's delegation comprises young professionals specializing in agriculture, forestry, fisheries, animal husbandry, floriculture, controlled-environment agriculture, fruit and vegetable production and marketing, and livestock farming.
The delegation is scheduled to leave Taiwan on Nov. 8 for an eight-day visit to the Netherlands, during which its members will engage with their Dutch counterparts to strengthen bilateral cooperation in floriculture, controlled-environment agriculture, livestock farming, and fruit and vegetable production and marketing, MOFA said in a press release.

content:
林外长呼吁中国遵循APEC峰会既定惯例 - 聚焦台湾
林外长呼吁中国遵循APEC峰会惯例
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月2日电 台湾外交部长林佳龙周一呼吁中国按照惯例正式邀请台湾参加亚太经合组织(APEC)峰会，并强调尽管中国给予台湾“差别待遇”，台湾仍将维护其参与权利。
《自由时报》周一早些时候发表的一篇报道援引未透露姓名的政府消息人士的话称，中国作为 2026 年 APEC 的东道主，最近向台湾发出了一封信函，而不是正式邀请台湾参加即将于 11 月 18 日至 19 日在深圳举行的 APEC 峰会。
报道称，这封信没有提及台湾在亚太经合组织内的正式名称“中华台北”，并降低了台湾的地位。
周一晚些时候在台北被要求对该报告发表评论时，林说台湾是亚太经合组织的正式成员，并与所有其他成员经济体平等地参与该论坛。
不过，他指责中国在今年举办各种APEC会议时一再对台湾实施“差别待遇”。
林说，例如，中国没有安排官员亲自向台湾递交APEC邀请函，而是选择发送电子邮件。
他指出，这封电子邮件确实用亚太经合组织的官方名称“中华台北”来指代台湾。
台湾外交部长林家龙。中央通讯社照片2026年10月28日
林郑月娥呼吁中方恪守举办APEC峰会的既定做法。
林补充说：“我们将立即对任何违反惯例的行为提出抗议，但我们不会因此而放弃参与的权利。”
APEC成立于1989年，是一个由环太平洋地区21个成员经济体组成的政府间论坛，旨在促进整个亚太地区的自由贸易。台湾和中国都是APEC正式成员。
中国已两次主办亚太经合组织峰会，第一次是2001年，第二次是2014年。
2001年，时任总统陈水扁领导的民进党政府，北京发传真拒绝了台湾选择前国家副主席李元簇出席APEC峰会的特使。台北随后决定抵制该活动。
2014年，时任总统马英九的国民党政府执政，与北京关系升温，中国派时任台办副主任龚清概在台北亲自向时任陆委会主任王郁琦转达邀请。

FM Lin calls on China to follow established practice for APEC summits
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 2 (CNA) Taiwan's Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) on Monday called on China to follow established practice in formally inviting Taiwan to the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, stressing that Taiwan will uphold its right to participate despite what he described as China's "differential treatment."
A Chinese-language Liberty Times report published early Monday, citing unnamed government sources, said that China, as the host of APEC in 2026, recently sent a letter rather than a formal official invitation to Taiwan to attend the upcoming APEC summit, scheduled to take place in Shenzhen on Nov. 18-19.
The letter did not refer to Taiwan by its official name within APEC, "Chinese Taipei," and downgraded Taiwan's status, according to the report.
Asked to comment on the report in Taipei later Monday, Lin said Taiwan is a full APEC member and has participated in the forum on an equal footing with all other member economies.
However, he accused China of repeatedly subjecting Taiwan to "differential treatment" while hosting various APEC meetings this year.
For example, China did not arrange for an official to personally deliver the APEC invitation to Taiwan, opting instead to send an email, Lin said.
He noted that the email did refer to Taiwan by its official APEC designation, "Chinese Taipei."
Taiwan's Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung. CNA photo Oct. 28, 2026
Lin called on China to adhere to established practices for hosting APEC summits.
"We will lodge an immediate protest against any action that violates established practices, but we will not, as a result, forfeit our right to participate," Lin added.
Established in 1989, APEC is an intergovernmental forum comprising 21 member economies in the Pacific Rim that promotes free trade throughout the Asia-Pacific region. Taiwan and China are both full APEC members.
China has hosted the APEC summit twice, first in 2001 and again in 2014.
In 2001, under the then-ruling Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) government of President Chen Shui-bian (陳水扁), Beijing sent a fax and rejected Taiwan's choice of special envoy, former Vice President Li Yuan-zu (李元簇), to attend the APEC summit. Taipei subsequently decided to boycott the event.
In 2014, when the Kuomintang (KMT) government of then-President Ma Ying-jeou (馬英九) was in power and ties with Beijing were warming, China sent then-Taiwan Affairs Office Deputy Director Gong Qinggai (龔清概) to personally deliver the invitation to then-Mainland Affairs Council Minister Wang Yu-chi (王郁琦) in Taipei.

优质旅游需求增长，台湾旅游展预计吸引 40 万游客 - 聚焦台湾
随着优质旅行需求的增长，台湾旅游展预计将吸引 40 万游客
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
这张 CNA 档案照片中的潜在游客参观台湾旅游展
中新社台北11月2日电 台湾国际旅展(ITF)主席周一表示，该展主办方希望今年能吸引超过40万名游客，年轻游客越来越多地寻求独特的体验，而不仅仅是讨价还价。
在台北举行的活动前新闻发布会上，台湾观光协会会长简余晏表示，早鸟票销量比去年增长了10%以上，去年参观人数超过36万人。
为庆祝其成立 40 周年，该展会将于 11 月 6 日至 9 日在台北南港展览馆一号馆举行，共有来自 123 个国家和城市的 550 多家参展商，占据 1,600 个展位。
“过去，人们来旅游展是为了获得物有所值的优惠和折扣餐券，”Chien 说。
“但我们发现，年轻旅行者越来越多地购买价格更高、独特的旅行，他们希望一生中至少体验一次。”
她说，极地探险、极光观赏之旅和欧洲行程等产品引起了人们的兴趣，并以每人 490,000 新台币（15,033 美元）的棒球之旅为例，很快就售空了。
钱说，旅行社推出了更多优质套餐，而西班牙朝圣路线和极光之旅对年轻顾客尤其有吸引力。与此同时，年长的旅行者往往更喜欢游轮。
她说，日本馆、菲律宾和旅行社的展位分配都达到了新高。
钱表示，尽管总体展位数量与去年相似，但私营部门的参与有所增加，而政府的参与因预算削减而减少。
她说，航空公司和旅行社早在展会之前就开始推销他们的产品，而一些未参加 ITF 的公司也举办在线销售活动，以满足需求。
钱表示，机票价格上涨和海外冲突并没有浇灭台湾消费者的旅游热情，尽管游客正在调整目的地以避免陷入困境的地区。
展会将展示国内和国际旅游产品，包括铁路旅行、游轮和主题行程。

Taiwan travel fair eyes 400,000 visitors as premium trip demand grows - Focus Taiwan
Taiwan travel fair eyes 400,000 visitors as premium trip demand grows
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Prospective travelers visit a Taiwanese travel fair in this CNA file photo
Taipei, Nov. 2 (CNA) Organizers of the Taiwan International Travel Fair (ITF) hope to attract more than 400,000 visitors this year, with younger travelers increasingly seeking distinctive experiences rather than bargains alone, the organizer's chairwoman said Monday.
At a pre-event press conference in Taipei, Taiwan Visitors Association Chairwoman Chien Yu-yen (簡余晏) said early-bird ticket sales had risen more than 10 percent from last year, when attendance exceeded 360,000.
The fair, celebrating its 40th anniversary, will run Nov. 6-9 at Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center, Hall 1, featuring over 550 exhibitors occupying 1,600 booths representing 123 countries and cities.
"In the past, people came to the travel fair for value-for-money deals and discounted meal vouchers," Chien said.
"But we're finding that younger travelers are increasingly buying higher-priced, distinctive trips they want to experience at least once in their lives."
Polar expeditions, aurora-viewing trips and European itineraries were among the products drawing interest, she said, citing a baseball tour priced at NT$490,000 (US$15,033) per person that sold out quickly.
Travel agencies were responding with more premium packages, while pilgrimage routes in Spain and aurora tours were particularly appealing to younger customers, Chien said. Older travelers, meanwhile, tended to favor cruises.
Booth allocations for the Japan Pavilion, the Philippines, and travel agencies had reached new highs, she said.
Although the overall booth count remained similar to last year, private sector participation had increased while government presences were down following budget cuts, according to Chien.
Airlines and travel agencies began promoting their offerings well before the exhibition, while some companies not participating in the ITF were also holding online sales to capitalize on demand, she said.
Chien said higher airfares and overseas conflicts are not extinguishing Taiwanese consumers' enthusiasm for travel, though travelers are adjusting their destinations to avoid troubled areas.
The fair will feature both domestic and international travel products, including rail journeys, cruises and themed itineraries.

由于 C3RB3r 勒索软件攻击激增，台湾网络附加存储 (NAS) 设备制造商 Synology 警告客户立即更新其设备。
该公司敦促用户启用自动更新并将其 NAS 设备上运行的 DiskStation Manager (DSM) 软件升级到最新版本，以保护他们的数据。
“Synology 已发现威胁行为者利用 2024 年 12 月修补的漏洞来攻击运行过时版本 DSM 的设备。这些攻击的目的是加密数据并勒索赎金，”该公司在周四的通报中表示。
“Synology 强烈敦促所有运行易受攻击版本的用户立即更新 DSM 以保护其系统。Synology 还建议启用自动更新以使 DSM 始终保持最新状态。”
当 BleepingComputer 寻求有关这些 C3RB3r 勒索软件攻击的更多信息时，未能立即联系到 Synology 发言人。
虽然 Synology 尚未透露这些持续攻击中利用的是哪个漏洞，但它链接到 2024 年 11 月的安全公告，其中包含针对漏洞发布的补丁信息，允许攻击者在未修补的设备上执行任意代码 (CVE-2024-10441)、读取文件 (CVE-2024-50629) 和写入文件 (CVE-2024-10445)。
建议 Synology 用户立即阻止从 Internet 对管理 Web 界面的访问，并更新其 DSM 软件，以阻止攻击者尝试破解和加密其设备。
产品严重性固定版本可用性 DSM 7.2.2 重要升级到 7.2.2-72806-1 或更高版本。 DSM 7.2.1 重要升级至 7.2.1-69057-6 或更高版本。 DSM 7.2 重要升级至 7.2-64570-4 或更高版本。 DSM 7.1 重要升级至 7.1.1-42962-7 或更高版本。 DSM 6.2 中等升级至 6.2.4-25556-8 或更高版本。
Synology 很少发布针对其客户设备的攻击的安全公告，最后一次此类警报发布于 2019 年 8 月，当时发生了导致 eCh0raix 勒索软件感染的大规模暴力攻击。
上周发布的公告是在 Synology 客户收到大量报告后发布的，这些客户的数据已被加密，并被提示从暗网门户以数千美元购买“C3rb3r Decryptor”工具。
第一份报告于两周前出现，受影响的用户表示勒索软件释放了勒索信息 (read-me3.txt)，并在加密文件中添加了 .L0CK3D 扩展名。
“你所有的重要文件都已被加密。任何使用第三方软件恢复文件的尝试都将对你的文件造成致命的伤害！安全解密文件的唯一方法是购买特殊的解密软件‘C3rb3r Decryptor’，”勒索信中警告道。
“在此页面上，您将收到如何购买解密软件来恢复所有文件的完整说明。此外，在此页面上，您将能够免费恢复任何一个文件，以确保‘C3rb3r Decryptor’能够帮助您。”
Cerber 勒索软件（也称为 C3RB3R 和 CerberImposter）目前部署在针对 Synology NAS 设备的攻击中，该勒索软件借用了 2016 年出现的臭名昭著的勒索软件即服务 (RaaS) 的名称。
在 2019 年底消失之前，旧的 Cerber 勒索软件操作占所有勒索软件攻击的 80% 以上，占 e 上所有勒索软件感染的四分之一。

Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices
Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices
Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices
Taiwanese network-attached storage (NAS) appliance maker Synology warned customers to update their devices immediately due to a surge in C3RB3r ransomware attacks.
The company urged users to enable automatic updates and upgrade the DiskStation Manager (DSM) software running on their NAS devices to the latest version to protect their data.
"Synology has identified threat actors exploiting a vulnerability patched in December 2024 to target devices running outdated versions of DSM. These attacks aim to encrypt data and extort ransom," it said in a Thursday advisory.
"Synology strongly urges all users running vulnerable versions to update DSM immediately to protect their systems. Synology also recommends enabling automatic updates to keep DSM up to date at all times."
A Synology spokesperson was not immediately available when BleepingComputer reached out for more information on these C3RB3r ransomware attacks.
While Synology has yet to share which vulnerability is being exploited in these ongoing attacks, it linked to a November 2024 security advisory with information about patches released for vulnerabilities allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code (CVE-2024-10441), read files (CVE-2024-50629), and write files (CVE-2024-10445) on unpatched devices.
Synology users are advised to immediately block access to the management web interface from the Internet and update their DSM software to block attackers' attempts to hack and encrypt their devices.
Product Severity Fixed Release Availability DSM 7.2.2 Critical Upgrade to 7.2.2-72806-1 or above. DSM 7.2.1 Critical Upgrade to 7.2.1-69057-6 or above. DSM 7.2 Critical Upgrade to 7.2-64570-4 or above. DSM 7.1 Critical Upgrade to 7.1.1-42962-7 or above. DSM 6.2 Moderate Upgrade to 6.2.4-25556-8 or above.
Synology rarely issues security advisories warning of attacks targeting its customers' devices, with the last such alert published in August 2019 following large-scale brute-force attacks that led to eCh0raix ransomware infections.
Last week's advisory follows a massive wave of reports from Synology customers whose data was encrypted and who were prompted to buy "C3rb3r Decryptor" tool from a dark web portal for thousands of dollars.
The first reports surfaced more than two weeks ago, with affected users saying the ransomware dropped a ransom note (read-me3.txt) and added a .L0CK3D extension to encrypted files.
"All your important files have been encrypted. Any attempts to restore your files with thrid-party software will be fatal for your files! The only way to decrypt your files safely is to buy the special decryption software 'C3rb3r Decryptor'," the ransom note warns.
"At this page you will receive the complete instructions how to buy the decryption software for restoring all your files. Also at this page you will be able to restore any one file for free to be sure 'C3rb3r Decryptor' will help you."
The Cerber ransomware (also known as C3RB3R and CerberImposter), now deployed in attacks targeting Synology NAS devices, borrowed its name from a notorious Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) with the same name that emerged in 2016.
Before disappearing at the end of 2019, the old Cerber ransomware operation accounted for more than 80% of all ransomware attacks and a quarter of all ransomware infections on enterprise endpoints.
Starting in December 2021, when it was first spotted, C3RB3R was also deployed on Atlassian Confluence and GitLab servers as part of several attack waves exploiting remote code execution (CVE-2021-26084 and CVE-2021-22205) and authentication bypass (CVE-2023-22518) flaws.
Internet threat watchdog Shadowserver now tracks over 380,000 Internet-exposed Synology NAS devices, but doesn't provide information on how many have already been secured against these attacks or are honeypots.

A Thai court has sentenced the political activist Arnon Nampa to an additional two years and eight months in prison for defaming the monarchy during a protest in 2020, bringing his total prison term to more than 34 years.

The 42-year-old has been in prison since 2023 on multiple charges under Thailand’s Article 112, commonly known as the lese-majeste law, which criminalizes criticisms of the Thai king or the royal family.

In a hearing on Friday at the Bangkok Criminal Court, Arnon and four other defendants – Wanwalee Thammasattaya, Phongsatorn Tancharoen, Promsorn Veerathamjaree, and Nawat Liangwattana – were sentenced to two years and eight months in prison on a fresh count of lese majeste, the AFP news agency [reported](https://www.arabnews.com/world/thailand-extends-activists-jail-term-to-more-than-34-years-3008982).

According to a [report](https://www.nationthailand.com/news/general/40072928) in Thailand’s The Nation newspaper, the charges stem from a 2020 protest that Arnon participated in front of the Siam Commercial Bank headquarters. During the protest, the defendants took turns delivering speeches calling “for the resignation of then prime minister General Prayut Chan-o-cha, constitutional amendments, and reform of the monarchy.”

Arnon’s lawyer Krisadang Nutcharut [told AFP](https://www.arabnews.com/world/thailand-extends-activists-jail-term-to-more-than-34-years-3008982) that Arnon was calling for increased transparency over a transfer of shares in Siam Commercial Bank, Thailand’s oldest bank, from the Crown Property Bureau. King Vajiralongkorn is the largest shareholder in SCBx, the bank’s parent company.

The defendants attempted to argue that their conduct was protected by the constitutional right to assembly. However, the judges ruled that the remarks exceeded lawful limits and insulted and defamed the monarchy. The Court initially sentenced each of them to four years in prison, which was [reduced](https://www.nationthailand.com/news/general/40072928) to two years and eight months each, stating that their testimony “was of some assistance to the proceedings.”

Arnon was one of the main leaders of the campaign of youth-dominated protests that erupted in the first half of 2020, after the court-ordered dissolution of the progressive Future Forward Party. Before they petered out in 2021, due to a combination of COVID-19 restrictions and state repression, the protests were notable for breaching the taboo on open discussion of the monarchy and its political role.

Thailand’s conservative establishment responded by initiating scores of lese-majeste complaints against the main leaders of the protest movement. Si

content:
美國中期選舉：民調顯示民主黨將取得勝利，但預測還準確嗎？ - BBC News 中文
Author, 安東尼·澤克爾（Anthony Zurcher）
民主黨帶著很高的期望迎接這場舉足輕重的美國中期選舉。
一位支持率創歷史新低的共和黨總統、對食品和各項帳單費用上漲心懷不滿的美國公眾，以及連續數月對民主黨有利的民調，都預示著週二對民主黨而言將是個美好的夜晚。
民調顯示，民主黨候選人在遠超218個議席的選區中領先，而218席正是奪取國會下院眾議院（House of Representatives）控制權所需的席位數。在關鍵的參議院（Senate）選戰中，他們與對手持平或略微領先。
《紐約時報》（New York Times）近期的一項民調顯示，南卡羅來納州（South Carolina）的參議院選戰呈現平局，而唐納德·特朗普（Donald Trump）2024 年在該州領先18個百分點。有線電視新聞網（CNN）近期的調查則顯示，民主黨在得克薩斯州（Texas）、堪薩斯州（Kansas）和緬因州（Maine）領先。
美國近年的政治史上，民意調查失準的例子比比皆是，即便是在選舉前幾天進行的民調也不例外。特朗普在2016年和2024年入主白宮的過程中，表現都超出預測。2020 年，他以微弱差距落敗，而當時多數調查顯示民主黨人喬·拜登（Joe Biden）將更輕鬆獲勝。
今年早些時候，民調顯示民主黨人阿卜杜勒·埃爾-賽義德（Abdul El-Sayed）有望在密歇根州（Michigan）民主黨參議員初選中以兩位數優勢獲勝。結果差距僅為1%。在威斯康星州（Wisconsin）民主黨州長初選中，一名民調領先幅度接近20個百分點的候選人，最終以不到一個百分點的差距敗北。
Play video, "What's at stake for Trump in the US midterms?", 節目全長 0,59
進行政治和市場研究調查的益普索公共事務部（Ipsos Public Affairs）總裁克利福德·揚（Clifford Young）表示，近年來民調變得困難，原因是美國人紛紛棄用座機並過濾來電，聯繫他們更加不易。而且，民調機構聯繫到的人當中，許多人參與的意願也有所下降。
台灣新北市長選戰：「政二代」蘇巧慧對決「專業副手」李四川，誰能拿下藍綠關鍵一城？
「保守派，尤其是極右翼保守派，本質上更加反建制，」揚說。 「他們什麼都不參與。他們憎恨這個體制。這就是挑戰所在。」
如果共和黨選民被系統性地低估，而民調公司在建立投票模型時沒有考慮到這一點，那麼他們的數據可能會向民主黨傾斜。
特朗普在此前總統選舉中表現超出預期，一種解釋是，他的支持者——其中許多人並非經常投票的選民——以高於預期的人數湧向投票站。
這種不可預測性是近年來幾次明顯的民調失準的主要原因之一，儘管大多數信譽良好的民調的誤差只有幾個百分點。
在勢均力敵的選戰中，這幾個百分點就可能決定候選人的勝負。而今年，許多關鍵的參議院選戰都處於這樣狹窄的差距之內。
近年來，中期選舉的大選民調已被證明更為準確，部分原因是特朗普——以及他吸引心懷不滿的美國人前往投票的獨特能力——不在選票上。
2022年，民調顯示，儘管拜登的支持率低迷，民主黨仍將打破常規預期，避免遭遇選舉慘敗。
雖然民主黨最終失去了眾議院的控制權，但差距很小，而且民主黨保住了美國參議院的控制權。
雖然今年的初選結果確實帶來了更大的意外，但揚表示，初選歷來變數較大，選民更可能在最後一刻才做出決定。不應將此視為當前這批大選民調失準的跡象。
近年來最引人注目的例子之一發生在 2010 年，當時共和黨人從民主黨手中奪得 60 多個眾議院席位，並在參議院也取得了進展。
那次選舉的背景是，經濟仍在從金融危機中艱難復甦，以及保守派對總統巴拉克·奧巴馬（Barack Obama）醫療改革的擔憂。民調曾預測民主黨會失利，但沒有預料到規模如此之大。
這次角色互換，民主黨成為反對黨，經濟議題成為選民關注的焦點。但鑑於特朗普的低支持率，民主黨的表現可能不會像歷史經驗所顯示的那樣好，也不會像一些人預期的那樣出色，原因有很多。
首先，這次選舉中涉及的大部分地區，特朗普在兩年前的總統選舉中都輕鬆拿下。對共和黨來說，這就像是主場比賽一樣。
其次，多年來眾議院選區邊界的調整，使得在兩黨之間易手的議席減少。
第三，由於國家的兩極分化加深，搖擺選民減少。一些專家形容選民群體已經僵化。
此外，共和黨一直享有資金優勢，這使他們在最後幾週有數億美元可用於投放攻擊性廣告。
Play video, "Voter voices: What issues matter most to Americans", 節目全長 1,16
民意調查模型旨在捕捉基本面的變化。精心設計的民意調查會預先考慮可能降低其可靠性的因素。
單一民調都存在固有的誤差範圍，這是基於樣本量與總體比例的統計不確定性。綜合來看，民調平均值而非單一調查結果可以提供更準確的預測。
目前來看，即使是像近幾屆總統選舉那樣的民調傾向，也顯示民主黨在11月3日晚上可能會取得不錯的成績。而且，民調失準可能偏向任何一方。在去年的州選舉和特別選舉中，民主黨的表現優於大多數民調預測，因為他們的選民投票率遠超預期。
特朗普在競選的最後幾天，在他2024年輕鬆獲勝的州舉行集會，這一景象提振了民主黨人的希望，他們認為共和黨內部民調顯示保守派候選人處境艱難。
有時，後期的轉向會改變一場選戰的態勢。有時，未決定的選民——在許多此類選戰中他們仍佔選民的重要部分——會全部倒向同一方。
在民調中，總會存在一定程度的不確定性，而管理這種不確定性，正是與科學相伴的藝術。
「我認為我們做得更好了，」揚說。 「但我們一直面臨的問題不僅僅在於民調機構，部分原因在於我們正在和人打交道。人可不是那麼容易對付的。」
本文原以英文撰寫，我們使用了人工智能協助翻譯，並由BBC記者在發佈前進行審核。了解更多關於我們如何使用人工智能的資訊。

You're either looking at a company to join, or you're trying to understand what your competitors are doing. Either way, you're researching blind—reading scattered reviews, googling company news, checking LinkedIn. It takes forever and you miss things.
Stop doing this manually.
In this workshop, you'll customize and deploy a working AI research agent in 3 hours. Fork an existing competitive intelligence agent, wire in your own data sources (RSS feeds, APIs, whatever's available), and run it. Feed it a company or industry keyword. Get back structured intelligence: recent news, hiring patterns, market positioning, gaps, red flags.
Clone a working competitive intelligence agent from GitHub
Add your own custom data sources (RSS feeds, open APIs, etc.)
Test it live on a real company or competitor
Walk away with a deployed agent you can run 100+ times
Two use cases, one agent:
Job Seeker Mode — Research a company before you apply, interview, or accept an offer. Understand growth, hiring, leadership, red flags.
Competitive Mode — Understand what competitors are doing, market gaps, hiring trends, strategic moves. For employees and side hustlers.

A laptop with a browser (Claude.ai)
Basic comfort with Claude—you should already be asking it questions and iterating

Optional upsell: Advanced agent techniques course (separate paid offering)

content:
Morning Meditation Wake Up Together with Trina Truong, Wed, Nov 4, 2026, 6:30 AM | Meetup
Morning Meditation Wake Up Together with Trina Truong
Wake Up Together is an online meditation community that was established in 2020 by Trina Truong and partners. Our mission is to help support individuals in maintaining a solid meditation practice through practicing in an accessible and open-minded community. We meet every day, virtually. While we are rooted in the Vipassana-Insight tradition, our approach is also inclusive to all Buddhist meditation practices such as anapanasati (mindfulness of the breath), Metta (loving-kindness), body scans, Zen, ton glen, and others.
The space that our meditators come to know is one that expresses itself as welcoming and embodying all views and interpretations of spirituality.
We hold the commitment to remain humble and vulnerable in our role as the door openers to the individual's inner journey. We aspire to shape the experience for participants to experience serenity, clear-seeing and profound understanding of the mind, and the [no] self through the practices, the guidance, the teachings, and the reflections offered in group sharing.
To solidify this spiritual aspiration is to make a commitment to sit in community with a predetermined frequency or as often as you can.
We welcome you to join our beloved community!
These guided meditations are offered daily and given freely. There
are no up-front fees. Wake Up Together is 100% donation based,
relying on your support and generosity.

content:
Mandarin Corner - Reading Room, Tue, Nov 10, 2026, 7:00 PM | Meetup
We use the website Chairman's Bao to provide the material for this call. The website will be shared during the call so you do not need your own subscription. We will be reading passages extracted from current newspaper articles at a level of HSK 3 and HSK 4. We will takes turns reading the sentences in Chinese and translating after reviewing a vocabulary list. Then we will listen to a native speaker read the passage and finally we will again read the article focusing on improved smoothness of our reading.
If you are studying independently, this is a great opportunity to talk with other learners and share notes. If you're looking for a structured activity, we recommend that you attend our third Tuesday events.
We make a conscious effort to balance talking about Mandarin with speaking the language. We learn the most through practice and feedback. It's the most fun to learn with other people.

My name is James Alan Smith. I’m an avid outdoorsman, fisherman and traveller. It’s seemingly huge, but in reality only as thick as the skin on an onion, scaled down. Know that this structure will be inhabited by my son and I, though having done years of research I know by using the wood on my property, solar gain and utilizing prevailing westerly winds that I can achieve energy and corporate independence and hopefully share my successes with the public in the pursuit of carbon negativity. I have the land, am planting fruit and nut trees, with Nitrogen fixing trees and shrubs. I have worked very hard, running a contracting business and know the value of a dollar putting myself through College scalloping way off NY, salmon fishing off CA and mating of Montauk and Captree Island during summers when school was off.
I plan on starting a YouTube channel to none other than get the word out, being a Teacher at heart. ANY donation will be greatly appreciated and know that as a believer in miracles, NO money will be wasted or spent irresponsibly.
I also plan on writing a book to share my/our progress, initiatives, inventions, observations, mistakes, joys and frustrations. There are 61 acres, half of which are free, more or less for planting (via Permaculture methods) and raising livestock for food gaining complete self sufficiency, selling surplus for cash, maybe jams, JimJam. lol

content:
Fundraiser by Sean Dineen : Sean dineen's mission to get my dissertation published
Sean Dineen is organizing this fundraiser.
Support My Mission to Empower the Exceptionality Community
As a person with cerebral palsy and many years advocating for people with exceptionalities, I’ve seen firsthand how society often dismisses their potential. Many are denied opportunities and classified in ways that stifle their growth, creating dependency instead of independence. This is not just morally unacceptable—it holds society back from innovation and progress. When my wheelchair got mislaid, I crawled through the streets.
My research challenges these norms. By exploring how nondemocratic societies like Taiwan and apartheid South Africa engaged with the exceptionality community, I’ve uncovered surprising insights. These nations, despite their flaws, prioritized accessibility and genuine inclusion, consulting directly with the communities they aimed to serve. My work highlights how these approaches can inform global policies to create more inclusive and thriving societies.
Now, I need your help to complete this vital research. I’ve traveled extensively, gathering data from South Africa, Australia, and the U.S. But key documents are located in one South African city, while interviews with 13 political leaders are required in another. As someone with cerebral palsy, I also need two assistants to make my travel and research possible.
I’ve raised $1,500 toward my $10,000 goal, but I still need $8,500 to finish. Completing this dissertation is not just a personal milestone—it’s a step toward improving opportunities for the exceptionality community worldwide.
Your support, no matter the amount, will make a difference. Together, we can replace outdated perceptions with true inclusion, unlocking the potential of millions.
Thank you for joining me in this mission.
